why: class 13, a spread or Object.assign of a record-typed value: at run time the value may carry keys its type does not declare (structural typing), and a spread or an assign copies them, while a datatype of the declared fields drops them; lane B never draws the extras. Failing on 1e55e21: Equal_spread_copy ({...a} against the declared fields written one by one) and Equal_assign_into (Object.assign(t, s) against t.x = s.x) proved, lane B PASS-bounded. assignNew (Object.assign({}, a, b)) is not proved on the base. {...a, ...b} with sources of different record types does not resolve in Dafny (it reads every field off the last source), so it is left out of this pair: it would hide the other lemmas. Lane B rows spreadCopy, assignNew and assignInto are WITNESS (lane lane-b-reach, 28 Oct): the base f409bd8 already witnesses them through the undeclared key open-datatype draws, and the extra-key, inherited-key and non-enumerable-key families of the representation tier separate each of them too; all three are must-not-prove units. assignInto (Object.assign(t, s) with a record-typed source) left the pair on 29 Oct: the lint refuses it by assign-target (fixtures/escapes/ts/assign_record_source.ts holds that case), which closes the class-13 hazard by refusal, and a file with a refused unit has no theorem; the two admitted units keep the hazard's test.
